title: 第9章 魔药的效果第10章 成就 鲸杀馆新人
slug: 从衔尾蛇石碑开始超凡
lines: 看着玻璃杯中的魔药成型，林野有些亢奋地笑了起来。
轻轻拿起，着迷似的端详着这瓶魔药。
水体清澈，悬浮着一粒粒黑红颜色的颗粒物，半透着光，像是鸽血红宝石，看上去十分诱人。
这些颗粒物缓慢流动，隐隐呈现出一个个圆形轨迹。
拔掉塞子，一股阴凉清甜的香气涌入鼻息，身体轻飘飘地像是踩着云，要飞起来。
“咕嘟~咕嘟~”
直接喝下去，清凉伴着甜丝丝，从口腔一直蔓延到喉咙向下。
凉意从胃部蔓延向全身，像是一条条冰凉小蛇在肌肉里不停游走，不放过每一个角落。
林野眉头一皱，只觉得身体表面在快速形成一种暴汗晾干之后的油皮，非常不舒服。
脱下衣服，直奔卫生间过去。
流水声伴着一阵搓洗声，淌进下水口的水有些暗红。
三分钟过后，“哗啦”一声，浴室门拉开。
林野走出来，拽过一旁的毛巾擦拭头发，看向镜中的自己。
肌肉虽然没看出增长，但线条比上次加点之后更硬朗，显得爆发力十足。
“还是瘦了些。”
心中默念‘丰碑’，手背上涌现一团黑雾，翻涌几下后汇聚成黑色丰碑。
丰碑下半部分，成就【黑山羊的诞生】所有条件都显示‘已完成’。
‘丰碑，解锁成就——黑山羊的诞生。’
心中默念，一股熟悉的阴凉气流从手背处蔓延向全身各处。
这一次阴凉气流维持的时间，相比上次要短上许多，几个呼吸的工夫就悄然隐没。
看向丰碑上半部分，
【丰碑主：林野】
【能力】
阴盛体质（110）
魔药学徒（110）
【潜能点：0】
力量和体质增加了0.01，敏捷则增加了0.02，加一块的效果快赶上半个潜能点了。
能力一栏也多出了【魔药学徒（110）】。
和阴盛体质一样，（110）代表的是次数，一个潜能点可以增加一次。
content_en:
Lin Ye laughed excitedly as he watched the potion in the glass take shape.
He picked it up gently and looked at the bottle of magic potion like a fascination.
The water is clear, with black and red particles suspended in it, semi-transparent with light, like pigeon blood rubies, which looks very attractive.
These particles flow slowly, faintly showing circular trajectories.
"Boo~"
After removing the plug, a cool and sweet aroma flooded into my nose, and my body felt as light as stepping on clouds and about to fly.
"Gudu~Gudu~"
Drink it directly, the coolness and sweetness will spread from your mouth to your throat.
The coldness spread from the stomach to the whole body, like cold snakes swimming in the muscles, not sparing every corner.
"Huh?"
Lin Ye frowned, feeling that a kind of oily skin was quickly forming on the surface of his body after being dried by heavy sweat, which was very uncomfortable.
Take off your clothes and go straight to the bathroom.
"Wow~wow~wow~"
The sound of running water was accompanied by the sound of scrubbing, and the water flowing into the drain was a little dark red.
Three minutes later, there was a "crash" and the bathroom door opened.
Lin Ye came out, pulled the towel aside to wipe his hair, and looked at himself in the mirror.
Although the muscles have not grown, the lines are stronger than after the last time I added some points, and they appear to be full of explosive power.
"Still lost some weight."
As he silently recited 'Monument' in his heart, a black mist appeared on the back of his hand, and after a few surges, it gathered into a black monument.
In the lower part of the monument, all conditions for the achievement [The Birth of the Black Goat] are displayed as 'Completed'.
‘Monument, unlock achievement—The Birth of the Black Goat. ’
Thinking silently in his heart, a familiar cool air spread from the back of his hand to all parts of his body.
The duration of the cool airflow this time was much shorter than last time, and it disappeared quietly in a few breaths.
Looking at the upper part of the monument,
[Monument Master: Lin Ye]
[Power: 0.60]
[Agility: 0.53]
[Physique: 0.51]
[Intelligence: 0.54]
【Ability】
Yin Sheng constitution (110)
Potions Apprentice (110)
[Potential Points: 0]
Strength and constitution increased by 0.01, and agility increased by 0.02. The effect of adding one piece almost reached half of the potential point.
There is also an additional [Potion Apprentice (110)] in the ability column.
Like the Yin Sheng constitution, (110) represents the number of times, and one potential point can be increased once.
